mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_governance.role_migration_task WHERE AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM auth_governance.role_migration_task WHERE AND id >#{after} AND old_role_id=#{oldRole} ORDER BY id LIMIT 21
SELECT FROM auth_governance.role_migration_item WHERE AND task_id=#{task} ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.role_migration_item WHERE AND old_grant_id=#{oldGrant} AND new_role_id=#{newRole})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_grant WHERE AND source_id=#{source} AND source_type='GROUP' AND group_id=#{group}source_type IN ('DIRECT','OA_REQUEST') AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.role_migration_task(id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,old_role_id,new_role_id,state,version,created_by,created_generation,command_id) VALUES(#{t.id},#{t.tenantId},#{t.applicationId},#{t.environment},#{t.oldRoleId},#{t.newRoleId},#{t.state},#{t.version},#{t.createdBy},#{t.createdGeneration},#{t.commandId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO auth_governance.role_migration_item(id,task_id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,old_grant_id,old_version,new_role_id,member_id,generation,old_source_id,scope,rule_json,scope_hash,valid_from,valid_to,original_hash,new_source_id,planned_grant_id,revoke_command,grant_command,stage,version,source_type,group_id,replacement_request_id) VALUES(#{e.id},#{e.taskId},#{e.tenantId},#{e.applicationId},#{e.environment},#{e.oldGrantId},#{e.oldVersion},#{e.newRoleId},#{e.memberId},#{e.generation},#{e.oldSourceId},#{e.scope},#{e.ruleJson},#{e.scopeHash},#{e.validFrom},#{e.validTo},#{e.originalHash},#{e.newSourceId},#{e.plannedGrantId},#{e.revokeCommand},#{e.grantCommand},#{e.stage},#{e.version},#{e.sourceType},#{e.groupId},#{e.replacementRequestId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.role_migration_item SET stage='CANCELLED',version=version+1,reason='TASK_CANCELLED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND task_id=#{task} AND stage NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')

UPDATE auth_governance.role_migration_task SET version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),state= 'CANCELLED' CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.role_migration_item WHERE task_id=#{t.id} AND stage NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.role_migration_item WHERE task_id=#{t.id} AND stage IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED')) THEN 'FINISHED_WITH_FAILURES' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END
WHERE AND id=#{t.id} AND version=#{t.version} AND state='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pp.state='BLOCKED' OR d.state='BLOCKED' THEN 'BLOCKED' WHEN g.state='REVOKED''ACTIVE' AND g.version=#{version} AND r.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND o.state='APPLIED' AND pr.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND pp.state='READY' AND pp.desired_epoch=pp.applied_epoch AND pp.applied_epoch >=o.target_epoch AND d.state='READY' AND d.desired_epoch=d.applied_epoch THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PROCESSING' END status,r.operation_id FROM auth_governance.access_grant g JOIN auth_governance.policy_partition pp ON pp.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND pp.application_id=g.application_id AND pp.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.directory_fence d ON d.tenant_id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_grant_receipt r ON r.grant_id=g.id AND r.grant_version=#{version} LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_operation o ON o.id=r.operation_id AND o.fence_id=pp.id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_receipt pr ON pr.operation_id=o.id WHERE g.id=#{id} AND g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment}
